title: Pixelmapper test vector file
description: One file per packet type: protocol/vectors/<protocol>/<packet>.json. See README.md for field conventions.

packet.description: Spec name of the packet, e.g. ArtPoll, ArtPollReply, RDM, DUB_RESPONSE

source.description: where the bytes come from, e.g. 'Art-Net 4 rev 1.4dh, ArtPoll table' or 'E1.20-2010 Table 6-4' or 'tube_fw rdm.c'

hex.description: complete packet bytes (UDP payload resp. RDM wire bytes starting with 0xCC); whitespace is ignored

valid.description: false = a decoder must reject these bytes; fields then holds {'error': '<reason>'}

fields.description: decoded fields, snake_case spec names; see README.md
